text:
Avery Blake: Quick sync — assembling SLA evidence for NovaCare onboarding. Two quick decisions: (1) customer-facing latency = p95 or p99? (2) ledger format: raw CSV only or CSV + executive PDF? @Samir @Lena

Samir Desai: Customer-facing = p95. Internally we keep p99 for credits. Recommend CSV + one-page PDF summary (execs ask for a single page).

Lena Ortiz: Agree. Also call out measurement window and timezone in the PDF header. NovaCare requested a 21d rolling window and CET.

Avery Blake: OK: produce CSV ledger (detailed, header row), plus PDF summary with p95, 21d rolling, CET timezone.

Samir Desai: For the credit appendix include a compact table mapping uptime/latency to credit percentage. Example tiers work fine but tweak numbers if product team updates SLA.

Avery Blake: Can infra give the export command and recommended bundle filename?

infra-bot: automation: example export command:

```
rbx-observability export --customer novacare --range 21d --tz Europe/Paris --format csv --include-maintenance > novacare-uptime-21d.csv
zip novacare-sla-bundle-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).zip novacare-uptime-21d.csv sla-summary.pdf maintenance-audit.csv
```

infra-bot: automation: recommended bundle name pattern: sla-bundle-{customer}-{utc_ts}.zip

Lena Ortiz: Add a single-sentence note about expected onboarding noise: first 48h may show higher latency due to model warmup and dataset sync.

Avery Blake: I'll draft the PDF summary and the appendix table, then upload the bundle to /shared/novacare/onboarding/sla_packages and ping the AE for renewal-readiness.

Samir Desai: Also include a short README in the bundle with the dashboard link and steps to reproduce the export. Saves us back-and-forth.

Avery Blake: Will do. Thanks all. Closing thread after upload.

infra-bot: automation: upload complete -> /shared/novacare/onboarding/sla_packages/novacare-sla-bundle-20240415T120512Z.zip :white_check_mark:
